content: Recent preschool usability research reports hesitation around multi-step interfaces and greater fluency with immediate visual feedback; child-focused guidance emphasizes observing repeated taps, abandonment, and non-verbal cues rather than relying on verbal approval. For ages 4-7, make takeoff acknowledgement immediate, keep the penguin/ramp edge/landing visible, use animation and symbols instead of text, and test short sessions with children. Camera and timing thresholds remain game-specific and require playtesting.
